text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both showing modest gains despite an extreme fear reading, suggesting selective accumulation rather than panic selling. Bitcoin's dominance near 56.5% and a relatively thin 24-hour volume of $37B indicate cautious positioning, with traders unwilling to commit significant capital into this fearful environment. The slight deepening of fear over the past week points to sustained uncertainty, though the lack of major selloffs in either major asset hints that support levels are holding.
